# PCONFIG and the TME MSRs at CPL3 (ledger U1020-U1022): the i5-13600K (Windows, CPL3) vs Unicorn
# with the strict i5-13600K CPUID profile and cpl=3. Generated by Emulator/tools/isa/ref_pconfig.py
# (--write, do not edit):
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_pconfig_hw.txt --cpuid Emulator\data\cpuid_i5-13600k.txt
# PCONFIG: CPUID.(07H,0):EDX.PCONFIG[18] = 0 on this CPU (and CPL3) -> #UD on both; the hardware
# cannot tell which of the two #UD conditions it took
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc5 | rax=0x0 rbx=0x30028000 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc5 | rax=0x3 rbx=0x30028001 cpl=3
.byte 0xf0, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc5 | rax=0x0 rbx=0x30028000 cpl=3
# RDMSR / WRMSR of the TME MSRs at CPL3: #GP(0) on both (CPL is checked first; TME_EN = 0 here)
.byte 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x981 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x982 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x983 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x984 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x32 | rcx=0x87 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0x30 | rcx=0x982 rax=0x2 rdx=0x0 cpl=3
# CPUID leaf 1BH: all sub-leaves 0 on this CPU (the profile is its capture)
.byte 0x0f, 0xa2 | rax=0x1B rcx=0x0 cpl=3
.byte 0x0f, 0xa2 | rax=0x1B rcx=0x1 cpl=3
